slots.writingObjective: State as a fact about TextOS that a draft is checked against the brief it was written for, not only for accuracy.

One sentence for a search result: TextOS checks that every point the brief requires is covered by a sourced statement or a human-accepted exclusion, and a draft is previewed only when it is both accurate and complete against its brief.

Open on the reader's situation: an AI draft whose facts all check out but that skips half of what the brief asked for. Say that, for TextOS, a fact-check pass only proves the draft is grounded, not that it answers the brief. No date.
slots.buyerIntent: Is an accurate draft a finished draft?

slots.heading: How does TextOS know a draft answers its brief?
slots.writingObjective: Answer directly: a separate check, distinct from the fact-check, looks at three things (each point the brief requires is covered by a sourced statement or excluded with a reason a person accepted; the required sections are present; the target query is addressed), and a draft is previewed only if both checks pass.
slots.buyerIntent: What exactly is checked against my brief?

slots.heading: Accurate is not the same as complete
slots.writingObjective: Explain the failure this check exists for: a draft can be certified true while covering only one of the points the brief required, which TextOS calls an empty draft certified true; and that a two-sentence sample draft is now kept as the reference case the check must block.
slots.buyerIntent: How can a correct draft still fail me?

slots.heading: What counts as answering the brief
slots.writingObjective: Explain the rules in plain language: a statement with no supporting source does not count as covering a required point; a required point may be left out only when a person accepted the reason, and then the draft can pass; a missing required section blocks the draft.
slots.buyerIntent: Can the writer just mention a topic to tick the box?

slots.heading: What happens when a draft falls short
slots.writingObjective: Explain the consequence: an article is marked ready only after passing this check, otherwise it is blocked; the blocked result names the missing sections, the uncovered points and whether the target query was addressed; and the same check applies whichever writer produced the draft.
slots.buyerIntent: What do I see when a draft misses something?

slots.writingObjective: Caption the figure of this note in one factual sentence, grounded in the evidence it cites.

slots.heading: What this check does not tell you
slots.writingObjective: Be honest about the limits: the target query counts as addressed when its key words appear in the rendered text, which is not a judgment of quality; the check measures whether the draft answers the brief, not whether it is true; and TextOS does not claim that a pass guarantees useful content, which stays a human judgment.
slots.buyerIntent: Does a pass mean the article is good?

slots.heading: What to ask any AI writing vendor
slots.writingObjective: Give the buyer a short list of questions to put to any vendor, one per sentence, drawn from the mechanisms this note describes. Recommendations only, no claim about TextOS.
